summary: On August 31, 2026, MediciNova, Inc. delivered a Notice of Termination to YA II PN, Ltd. (Yorkville) to end its Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) dated July 30, 2025. The company had the right to issue up to $30 million of common stock but sold only 175,000 shares at $1.39-$1.40, yielding $0.2 million. No draws, borrowings, or fees remained. Termination effective September 8, 2026. This routine contract termination is not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply. Watch for any future financing alternatives.
